reason: The cited code serializes agent-supplied params and passes them into a page frame via frame.evaluate(callToolInPage, ...), so it can deliver data to the page/WebMCP tool, an untrusted/attacker-readable destination. The result is explicitly described as page-provided and untrusted, and is returned to the agent. The execution shown is in the browser page/frame context, not arbitrary host execution. The lines do not establish that the returned page-provided data is non-public or credential-backed secret data; that depends on the page/tool.
